name: git-pr
description: Rebase onto or merge in a PR's base branch with intent-preserving conflict resolution, and triage review-bot threads (CodeRabbit, Copilot, Greptile and others).

review_bots.title: Review bots
review_bots.description: GitHub logins whose review comments /check-bots triages, comma-separated, e.g. coderabbitai[bot],copilot-pull-request-reviewer[bot]. auto = every commenter GitHub marks as a bot.
